verdict.rationale: OpenHands has no dedicated feedback-to-spec feature. A product manager could assemble one from documented pieces: automations triggered by webhooks or Slack mentions that integrate with Linear and GitHub, an incident-triage automation that gathers context, suggests severity and routes issues, and a custom planning agent built with the SDK. Missing for 10: native intake of user-feedback submissions, structured task generation with proposed scope, a documented PM-facing workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
